name: BLOOD4-the-mirror-goes
old: return rng() < 0.5 ? { ...c, u0: c.u1, u1: c.u0 } : c;

name: BLOOD4-the-mirror-flips-the-cell-in-place
old: return rng() < 0.5 ? { ...c, u0: c.u1, u1: c.u0 } : c;
new: if (rng() < 0.5) { const t = c.u0; c.u0 = c.u1; c.u1 = t; } return c;

name: BLOOD4-the-mirror-is-vertical-so-runs-climb
old: return rng() < 0.5 ? { ...c, u0: c.u1, u1: c.u0 } : c;
new: return rng() < 0.5 ? { ...c, v0: c.v1, v1: c.v0 } : c;

name: BLOOD4-every-drip-runs-the-same-length
old: const runTo = ran ? -0.9 + rng() * 0.75 : 0.5;  // 0.5 == no run at all
new: const runTo = ran ? -0.85 : 0.5;  // 0.5 == no run at all

name: BLOOD4-the-run-never-wanders
old: const drift = (rng() * 2 - 1) * 0.22;           // where the run wanders to by its foot
new: const drift = 0;           // where the run wanders to by its foot

name: BLOOD4-every-bead-runs
old: const ran = rng() > 0.32;                       // a third of them never ran
new: const ran = true;                       // a third of them never ran
